 This role will be critical in redesigning how ads contribute to a personalized, relevant, and inspirational shopping experience, with the customer value proposition at the forefront. Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

 A day in the life
   

  

 As a Software Development Engineer, you will help build hyper\-scale online systems, offline data pipelines, and machine learning infrastructure—leveraging GenAI and LLMs to transform advertising and shopping experiences.
